title: Flatness of the embedded integral scalar map on the coefficient-sized site
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite intermediate field E of PadicAlgCl ell, an element pi of its embedded integers generating the maximal ideal, and a Noetherian scheme X. Let phi be the small-site scalar map of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]. The regular continuous integral coefficient module, restricted along phi to constant embedded coefficients, is flat as a sheaf of modules. This asserts only flatness, not finite type of the residue kernel, identification of its extension, or a quotient isomorphism.

source.place: Paragraph (1); Stacks proetale.tex, section-derived-completion-noetherian (099L); sites-modules.tex, lemma-completion-flat; algebraization.tex, lemma-restriction-derived-complete-equivalence (099I). Finite-type kernel uses the local single generator pi; flatness and canonical quotient are Stacks Tag 093M.

proof.text: Use the proved embedded-to-spectral continuous integer ring comparison, and compose it with the canonical pointComparison to the spectral condensed ring. Pull this isomorphism to X. The existing embeddedIntegralScalarKernelSquare supplies an isomorphism of the discrete coefficient rings and the commuting square for the actual scalar maps. Only its scalar-square clause is needed.

Take the flatness clause of integralModels_flat_residue for the finite extension ULift E. Reconstruct both isomorphisms as small-site ring-sheaf isomorphisms; sectionwise functoriality preserves their scalar square. Transport the local equational criterion across these two ring isomorphisms: lift coefficients and module entries using the inverses, factor the relation locally using spectral flatness, and map the matrix and entries forward. Ring-homomorphism and naturality identities prove the two factorization equations. The criterion and its tensor comparison give exactly the displayed IsFlat assertion. Finite-dimensionality of ULift E is transported by ULift.moduleEquiv. Empty sites and zero-length relations are covered by the same criterion.

lean.statement:
theorem integralModelsEmbeddedScalarFlat
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    let φ := IntegralModelsStacks.smallMap X (IntegralModelsEmbedded.scalarMap ℓ E X)
    SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u + 1}
      ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u + 1}
        ((sheafCompose (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).map φ)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (siteModuleRings _)))
